problem:
Given that the differential equation 

$$
\frac{{\text{d}}^{2}y}{\text{d}{x}^{2}}-3\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}+2y=4{x}^{2}-2
$$

has the complementary function ${y}_{c}(x)=A{e}^{x}+B{e}^{2x}$, find the particular solution ${y}_{p}(x)$ to this equation.

Question 15

Given that the differential equation d2ydx2−3dydx+2y=4x2−2 has the complementary function yc(x)=Aex+Be2x, find the particular solution yp(x) to this equation.

a
yp(x)=−x2+3x−4
b
yp(x)=2x2+5x+8
c
yp(x)=x2+2x+3
d
yp(x)=−2x2+4x+6
e
yp(x)=2x2+6x+6
